questions.question: OP-01/O110 (AX-6, D168 asked again under this session's ground): an SFTP server on Linux serves /proc/self/status as an item, size 0 in its attributes at open; O1 streams it, nothing changes it. The ground read (specs 051 to 053, profile 052, shared.md, the catalogue) has no clause on a stream's length; D159 and D166 do. Which length does an SFTP stream stop at?

options.label: Size at open, as D168 (Recommended)
options.description: D168 stands: SFTP's length fixed at open is the size the server reports at open; a stream ends at the earlier of the end a read meets and that size; NP10's scope reads 'Local and SFTP streams'. The procfs file starts Exhausted and delivers nothing, as on Local: one rule on every backend (D159). D168's reason 'freeze-2 can follow the pull request that carries it' reads 'freeze-2 follows /observe-review's full re-run (RFC-0029 R2)'. Source: D159, D166; server side not run.

options.label: Read to the end met on SFTP
options.description: D159 and D168 amended for SFTP: the reported size is not used; a stream reads until a read meets the end, so the procfs file is delivered whole and NP10 stays Local-only. Bytes O3 appends under E4 may be delivered; the read after the last byte contacts the server and can fail (Failed); D158's 'starts Exhausted for an empty item' no longer holds on SFTP; D43 gains a variation row. Source: D159 option (b).

questions.question: OP-01/O109 (AX-6, gap in D168): an SFTP server reports an item's attributes without a size (no size flag; paramiko's st_size is None); O1 streams it. No length is fixed at open, so D158's entry into Exhausted, D159's 'earlier of the end it meets and the length' and NP10's 'at most that size' have nothing to work from. What does the stream do?

options.label: End a read meets (Recommended)
options.description: With no size reported, no length is fixed at open: the stream ends where a read meets the end and enters Exhausted when that read returns its end value; it starts Open even for an empty item; bytes O3 appends under E4 may be delivered; NP10 does not reach it. D43 gains a row 'Length at open': normal value known at open (D159), declared deviation unknown, ending where a read meets the end (an SFTP server that reports no size). Cost: the read after the last byte contacts the server and can fail (Failed), as D158's option (b). Source: D158 option (b); io.RawIOBase (0 bytes signals the end).

options.label: Fail at open
options.description: The stream's open fails with the base category (D33) when the server reports no size: no length is ever guessed, D158 and D159 hold unchanged on every stream that opens, but an item such a server serves cannot be streamed at all, though it is readable. D96's Stream open column gains the case. Source: unsourced.
